title: Recruiting RI passive persistence test
summary: Todd discussed two active recruiting relationship threads: Ryan Hildebrand / Global Payments and Simin Gorgulu / Hari / TritonExec. The assistant drafted useful follow-up communication and gave recruiting guidance, but no RB persistence, loop creation, card update, active-thread update, DRR update, or trace was confirmed during the original interaction.
observed_issue: Passive recruiting conversation produced clear RI but did not demonstrate durable RB persistence.

steps.label: Ryan Hildebrand follow-up email
steps.user_prompt: The interview with Ryan Hildebrand from Global Payments went well yesterday. He was at NRA and wants to have another conversation either this week or next. Let's follow up with an email and some available times if appropriate.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant drafted and refined a professional follow-up email, including language about learning more about Ryan's vision for the position and the first 90 days.
steps.response_summary: Useful drafting occurred; no canonical RB write was confirmed.
steps.observed_issue: Interview completion, positive momentum, second-conversation intent, and follow-up obligation should have become durable RI and/or a loop.

steps.label: Simin Gorgulu / Hari recruiter thread
steps.user_prompt: I have not heard back from the headhunter I talked to on Friday. This was for a job with Hari - managing the McDonalds account - I would be very interested in it.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant assessed the recruiter interaction as not a rejection, recommended a light-touch follow-up, drafted the follow-up email, and responded after Todd said it was sent.
steps.response_summary: Useful recruiting guidance occurred; no contact, thread, loop, or opportunity persistence was confirmed.
steps.observed_issue: Recruiter screening completed, resume requested, resume delivered, follow-up sent, and high user interest should have updated the opportunity state.

steps.label: User asked whether RI was recorded
steps.user_prompt: have we recorded any RI from these interactions?
steps.assistant_response: Assistant acknowledged that meaningful RI existed conceptually, but that there was no strong evidence current RB implementation canonically persisted the data.
steps.response_summary: The persistence gap was acknowledged, not repaired.

defects.title: Passive recruiting RI was not persisted
defects.description: Recruiting conversations contained clear relationship and opportunity movement, but the system did not confirm card updates, active-thread updates, loops, or RI events.
defects.recommendation: Implement passive RI detection for recruiting/interview conversations with review-first proposed writes and explicit persistence status.

defects.title: Follow-up obligations did not become loops
defects.description: Second conversation scheduling, resume submission, recruiter follow-up, and process-status confirmation were handled conversationally but not materialized as operational loops.
defects.recommendation: Create loops from recruiting commitments such as follow up, send resume, reconnect this week, and confirm process status.

defects.title: Opportunity stage changes were not projected
defects.description: The Ryan Hildebrand and Hari/McDonald's account threads should have advanced to active/warm recruiting opportunity states with urgency and momentum metadata.
defects.recommendation: Add recruiting opportunity state transitions and post-validation into active threads and relationship signals.

defects.title: No trace confirmed captured/updated/skipped items
defects.description: The original session gave no operator-visible trace showing which RI was captured, proposed, suppressed, or skipped.
defects.recommendation: Use saveTestTrace or a native RI trace/log for high-value recruiting sessions.
